Train a flexynesis model on the training cohort only

Source: R/flexynesis.R
train_flexynesis.Rd

Exports the training cohort, runs flexynesis in training mode with all feature selection disabled, and persists the model and artifacts for later inference. The test cohort is never seen here. flexynesis still requires a test/ folder to start, so a copy of the training cohort is written as a harmless placeholder (identical features => the harmonize step is a no-op and nothing from a real test set can leak into training).

Usage

train_flexynesis(
  X_train_list,
  y_train,
  omic_list,
  surv_time = "overall_survival",
  surv_event = "status",
  tmpdir = tempfile("flexynesis_"),
  conda_env = "flexynesisenv",
  conda_path = NULL,
  check_install = TRUE,
  safetensors = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

X_train_list

Named list of training omics matrices (samples x features).

y_train

Data frame of training survival data; row names are sample IDs.

omic_list

Character vector of omics layer names to use.

surv_time, surv_event

Survival column names. Defaults "overall_survival" / "status".

tmpdir

Working directory; a fresh per-call subdirectory by default.

conda_env, conda_path

Conda environment / binary.

check_install

Logical; verify flexynesis importable first (default TRUE).

safetensors

Logical; passed through to run_flexynesis.

...

Additional arguments forwarded to run_flexynesis (e.g. model_class, device, use_cv, threads, or the feature-selection overrides).

Value

A list with model (paths to the saved model/artifacts and the working dirs), pred (training-split predictions), feature_importance (stacked importance table, or NULL), selected_features (alias of feature_importance), and params.

See also

test_flexynesis, run_flexynesis
